note: AS-IS BASELINE (plan ①, captured before any code change), scoped to what this change touches: the m/M/d launch path and the modeForm render. It shows the two defects structurally - `--fast` is decided ONCE in intentFor from the source config (no per-launch override exists anywhere), and `case modeForm` returns the form as the WHOLE view, so no background is drawn; the mode is assigned at 16 separate sites and only the pickers record where they came from.
